description_excerpt: General Description: Assistant Manager, Operations Risk & Control is a key member of Vietnam Operations Risk & Control (Ops Line 1B) and supports the effective and consistent management of operations-related risks and controls. The role operates within the first Line of Defense and provides hands-on risk and control oversight, challenge, coordination and reporting across Operations. The position works closely with Operations process and control owners (L1A), Regional L1B, Risk and other second-line functions, Compliance, Legal and Audit.
